name: branding-maroon-pink-star-wordmark-type-and-palette-board
title: Maroon and Pink Star Wordmark Board
whatItIs: A three-band board: a maroon panel with a chunky pink wordmark 'GOOD*STORE' with a smiling star, a sky-blue panel with a website statement annotated with typeface names, and a cream band with seven colour swatches and hex codes.
whatItMeans: A warm, sweet palette and bubbly letters give a cause-driven store an optimistic, friendly voice, and annotations link type to use.
techniques: Chunky rounded wordmark with a character-star as the divider
Labeled leader lines naming the typeface for each text role
Seven-swatch strip with names and hex codes
Blue mock section showing the type in context
Contrast of a slab-like serif body against a heavy sans headline

vocabulary.definition: A leader line labelling which typeface is used where.
A row of adjacent colour samples with codes.
A small mascot or star used in place of punctuation or a letter.
